                            ORDINANCE

   / r ORDAINED B Y THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION I . Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,

is hereby amended by changing all the Cl-2 Neighborhood Commercial District symbols

and indications as shown on Map No. 4-1 in the area bounded by


       A line 25 feet north of and parallel to West 21" Street; South
       Washtenaw Avenue; West 2P' Street; and the alley next west
       of and parallel to South Washtenaw Avenue,


to those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage

and due publication.

7.    On what date did the owner acquire legal title to the subject property?       2022

8.    Has the present owner previously rezoned this property? If Yes, when? No

9.    Present Zoning District: Cl-2                   Proposed Zoning District: B2-3

10.   Lot size in square feet (or dimensions): 3.125 sq. ft. (25 ft. x 125 ft.)

11.   Cmrent Use of the Property: The subiect propertv was improved with a three-story
      building containing seven (7) residential units and one (1) retail unit that appears to have
      been converted to a residential unit without a permit.

12.   Reason for rezoning the property: The Applicant is proposing to bring the existing grade
      level residential unit into compliance with the Chicago Zoning Ordinance.

13.   Describe the proposed use of the propeity after the rezoning. Indicate the number of
      dwelling unit number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial
      space; and height of the proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC): The Applicant is proposing
      to bring the existing grade level residential unit into full compliance with the Chicago
      Zoning Ordinance. Once, the zoning change is complete, the Applicant will seek a
      Variation pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1101-R to reduce the minimum lot area requirement to
      permit the eight (8) dwelling units total. The multi-unit building will then contain a total
      of eight (8) residential units and no retail units. No changes or expansions are proposed to
      the existing building's floor area total, height, or footprint. The two (2) existing off street
      parking spaces will remain without change. No new off-street parking is required because
      the subiect building is more than 50 years old.

14.   The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) requires on-site affordable housing units
      and/or a financial contribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that
      receive a zoning change which, among other triggers, increases the allowable floor area,
      or, for existing Planned Developments, increases the number of units (see attached fact
      sheet or visit www.cityofchicago.org/ARO for more information). Is this project subject to
      the ARO?

      YES             NO        X
